incident-bot: ALERT — canary-service: healthcheck failure rate > 8% for 3m, 5xx spike, severity=P2
Marta (oncall): seeing pager. i'm on it
Marta (oncall): early check: canary pool for v2.3.1 in us-west-2 showing elevated 502/503s, tail latency also up
Devon (infra): checking infra metrics — hosts show rising memory use + some kube restarts on the canary nodes
Aria (runtime): logs look like worker OOMs triggered during quantized execution path, GC churn high in pod logs
Marta (oncall): ok — is this affecting only canary traffic? customer traffic still on stable?
Devon (infra): yep stable (v2.3.0) healthy. only canary shard receiving 10% of traffic.
PagerBot: Incident created — INC-2026-332: canary-healthcheck-5xx-spike. Paging Marta, Aria, Devon, Lucas.
Lucas (sre): visible 5xx rate at edge 7.9% -> 12% on canary routes, some user sessions returning 502 errors
Marta (oncall): need quick assessment of customer impact. any high-severity customers on canary?
Devon (infra): cross-referenced canary assignment: no paid customers flagged, internal dev and non-critical prod test tenants. low customer impact, but could degrade production if rollout continues
Aria (runtime): root cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path in v2.3.1 triggers higher memory and pathologically large KV cache allocations for some long-seq requests. causes worker crash -> 5xx
Marta (oncall): mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to pause canary routing, 2) scale canary pods up temporarily, 3) immediate rollback of canary to v2.3.0.
Lucas (sre): scaling may mask but not fix underlying OOM, and could increase cost. prefer pause canary or rollback.
Marta (oncall): agree. flip flag to stop routing new requests to v2.3.1, keep current inflight allowed to finish. I'll do flag flip and watch.
Marta (oncall): @devon can you confirm flag CLI? where is the rollout gating?
Devon (infra): gate is in config-service: feature.flag.canary_v2.3.1 -> boolean. running curl now.
Devon (infra): ```bash
curl -X POST https://config-service.internal/flags/canary_v2.3.1 -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
Devon (infra): updated -> response 200 {"enabled":false} 
Marta (oncall): confirmed — traffic to v2.3.1 dropped from 10% -> 0% over last 30s
PagerBot: Config change event: feature.flag.canary_v2.3.1 set to false by devon at 2761234582
Aria (runtime): 5xx rate falling on canary routers, now down to 1.5% 
Marta (oncall): good. still want to roll back the deployment entirely to be safe and clear the canary pods?
Devon (infra): i'd prefer rollback to v2.3.0 and drain canary nodes. i'll queue a deployment rollback.
Marta (oncall): go ahead. Lucas — coordinate on-call handoff if this expands.
Lucas (sre): standing by for possible escalation.
Devon (infra): rolling back service/canary to v2.3.0 -> kubectl set image deployment/canary svc-image:v2.3.0 --record
Devon (infra): ```
kubectl rollout status deploy/canary -n prod --timeout=5m
# draining old pods afterwards
kubectl delete pod -l rollout=canary-v2.3.1 -n prod --grace-period=60
```
Devon (infra): rollout reported success at 2761234590
OpsBot: Deploy event — rollback to v2.3.0 completed by devon at 2761234590; monitors will re-evaluate
Marta (oncall): verify healthchecks and customer-facing metrics
Aria (runtime): healthchecks stable, 5xx back down to baseline ~0.3%, tail latency normalized
Lucas (sre): double-checking logs: no further OOMs on the canary nodes, kube restarts stopped
Marta (oncall): impact summary: brief canary-only spike caused 502/503 for internal/dev tenants; no paid customers directly impacted. mitigations: flag flip -> rollback. next steps: open an RCA with runtime and infra to root cause quantized kernel memory allocation and add canary gate checks to abort earlier.
Marta (oncall): I'll hand this over to daytime oncall in 10m. @lucas can you take incident ownership for RCA tracking?
Lucas (sre): taking ownership. creating INC-2026-332 RCA ticket and scheduling postmortem.
Aria (runtime): initial action items: add additional memory limits to canary pods, add a pre-rollout canary load test profile that exercises long sequence kv-cache flows, and add OOM alert threshold at 2% before healthcheck parity fails.
Devon (infra): i'll add a short-term guard: reject new canary rollouts that enable quantized kernel flag without a canary-smoke test passing.
Marta (oncall): thanks team. closing pager as mitigated.
PagerBot: Incident INC-2026-332 status -> mitigated at 2761234599 by Marta
Marta (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall: Lucas (sre) will own RCA and followups. good job everyone :thumbsup:
